title: Searching
summary: Finding things fast in ordered data.

articles.title: Lower bound
articles.summary: The first position whose value is not less than a key.
articles.idea_md: Keep a half-open window `[lo, hi)` that always contains the answer. Probe the middle: if it is smaller than the key, the answer lies to its right; otherwise the middle itself may be the answer, so keep it.
articles.applications_md: Insert positions in sorted arrays, counting values in a range, and searching over a monotone answer space.
articles.pitfall_md: Computing `(lo + hi) / 2` can overflow on large indices; `lo + (hi - lo) / 2` cannot.
